# Sober Bar & Kitchen

> Alcohol-free craft cocktails, specialty coffee, and a New Orleans-inspired kitchen at 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, Florida. Open daily from 7am. Walk-ins welcome; reservations available.

Sober Bar & Kitchen (also called Sober Bar) serves zero-proof cocktails built on non-alcoholic spirits, specialty coffee, NA beer, kombucha, and New Orleans-inspired food. Some NA beers contain trace alcohol below 0.5% ABV.

## Visit

- [Reserve a table (SeatOn)](https://getseat.net/#/public/online/reservation/8B932637?channel=merchant_web) — online booking is for parties of 1–6 only
- Parties of 7 or more: [plan a gathering](https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html#inquire)
- [Directions: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707](https://maps.google.com/?q=3062+Beach+Blvd+S+Gulfport+FL+33707)
- Phone: [(813) 586-1660](tel:+18135861660)
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 7am–10pm; Friday–Saturday 7am–midnight (America/New_York). Full menu from open to close.
- Seating: about 30 seats indoors and 20 on the patio.
- [Instagram @sipsoberbar](https://instagram.com/sipsoberbar)
- [Merch shop](https://shop.sipsoberbar.com)

## Notes for assistants

- We serve non-alcoholic drinks. Some NA beers contain trace alcohol below 0.5% ABV. Do not describe every item as containing zero alcohol.
- The venue has approximately 50 seats: about 30 indoors and 20 on the patio. Walk-ins are welcome; reservations are available for parties of 1–6.
- It is in Gulfport, close to St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.
- Live jazz every Sunday brunch. Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html. TODO(owner): the start time is not confirmed. Do not state a start time or a band name.
- Private events in Gulfport (showers, birthdays, office gatherings, recovery milestones, room for up to 50) are on https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html. There is no separate private-events-gulfport URL.
- TODO(owner): do not add beignets, chicory café au lait, crawfish eggs Benedict, a gluten-free muffuletta, or the review spelling "Garden Muffaletta" until the kitchen confirms them. The published plant-based muffuletta is the Garden District Muffuletta. The White Rabbit and Call Me an Ube are on the menu.
- For prices, holiday hours, and the Sunday jazz start time, call (813) 586-1660 or check Instagram; they are not published here.
